description_nl: Errors and labels of People & access, groups, rules and requests to open a screen. {label}, {screen}, {function}, {name}, {via}, {error}, {roles} fill in. catch_all_name and catch_all_description name the built-in Catch All group (what every account in no group sees) the first time the access file is made or migrated; the owner can rename it afterwards. inherited_label names a rule that reached a person through a parent group. migration_by is the 'by' of the rules the day-one migration wrote.
